en: This is the note with the Ark Plans

Aston,

The final evacuation raft is arriving tomorrow. As we both know, there is not enough room on this raft for all of us. It is with a heavy heart that I leave you behind with the remaining crew. Fear not, I will ensure another raft is dispatched shortly to rescue you.

For now, please take care of you and the rest of the crew.

- Dad

29 November 1948

I do not know why I am writing this. If anyone reads this, it is only because I am dead.

My meds are out and my condition is worsening by the hour.

Mr. Rothschild has brought this city a great deal of wealth and innovation. It is disappointing that we could not escape on his craft. It now rots in Crystal City and I shall soon be joining it.

I pray John will make it out somehow.

- Anne

28 January 1947

I have spent my entire life in Crystal City. Under this rope bridge, I now see my beloved city beneath the darkness of rising seawater. 
I can still make out the rooftops of buildings I once visited.

Mr. Rothschild promised us he would find a way for us to escape. And why should I not trust him? After all, he singlehanded built this city. Things worked out for a very long time, until the Maxwell brothers came along. These days, I am not so sure who to trust anymore.

There are 14 of us: Mr. Rothschild, his son, and the rest of us, with no certainty an evacuation raft will come. I sit beside the radio anxiously for news. With the seawater still rising after each earthquake, if we aren’t rescued soon, we will have to abandon this camp for another one.

- Ralph
